qualification_attempts.initial_backend: Admission supplied an extra argument to the strict digest validator; fixed before final matrices. The initial focused run failed 22 cases; the next run passed 33 with a clock mock exhausted by shared monotonic calls; the final focused run passed 34 unchanged assertions.

qualification_attempts.initial_browser: Download readiness failed in two attempts (35 and 34 passes). The final clean fixture waits for server completion, performs one UI refresh and verifies all 36 workflows. No timeout, assertion, dataset, skip or coverage budget was weakened.
qualification_attempts.coverage_scope: The existing explicit coverage source list omitted the new app. Added execution_jobs without changing gates/omissions; both full suites are repeated for the expanded final coverage basis.
qualification_attempts.expiry_review: Final review found one-hour expiry checked only before starting. Added active checkpoint and publication checks plus two regressions; 36 focused cases pass. Superseded expanded-coverage runners were stopped by their exact P22 report-path ownership; final matrices use the stable corrected source.
